title: Work together around a clear technical question
description: Potential collaboration could address optical measurement conditions, photonic design workflows or independent validation. These are discussion topics, not statements that a partner arrangement already exists.
lead: Potential collaboration could address optical measurement conditions, photonic design workflows or independent validation. These are discussion topics, not statements that a partner arrangement already exists.

sections.heading: For sensing researchers
body: A useful proposal might define an analyte, sample preparation, reference method and sources of variation. Joint work would need explicit responsibilities and a study design before any performance claim could be made.

sections.heading: For photonic engineers
body: A design discussion could focus on process assumptions, simulation reproducibility and agreement with independent results. The glucose-chip example is a design case, not evidence of a deployed or measured product.

sections.heading: Begin with scope and evidence
body: Explain the question, what information can be shared, what outcome would be useful and how success might be tested. The preview form only creates a local test receipt; no external partner is contacted by submitting it here.
